en: Yes, yes, all of the Horde's and Alliance's war materiel is being shipped over to Silithus and should be there within a day. Do you know what happens then, $c? We hurry up and wait. Hopefully someone is gathering the pieces of the Scepter of the Shifting Sands, because in order to open the gates of Ahn'Qiraj it needs to be rung against the gong on the Scarab Dais.

You have <snort> aided Mangletooth more than I would have dreamed, $r.$B$BThank you.$B$BAs long as I remain a captive here, you may bring me blood shards from the Bristleback quilboar and I will bless you with Agamaggan's power.
So you're here for the Warsong axes. Well, it's about time, $n. That crate has been sitting out there for days, now.$B$BFeel free to haul it away whenever you are ready.
Hey guys, let's try on the other side.
The Arch Druid believes that Ivus the Forest Lord will come once he is made aware of the destructive forces within this valley.
The Alliance Flag was dropped by $n!
The craft of the night elves ranges beyond the woods and its denizens.  We know much of the earth below, and of the metals within it.

Yes, you heard true, $c, all of our collections are complete and the last of the war materiel should arrive in Silithus within a day. I am told that once all is assembled there, and our troops readied, someone from within the ranks of you heroes is going to ring the gong outside of Ahn'Qiraj, already having assembled the Scepter of the Shifting Sands to do so with. I hope that we don't have to wait too long for that to happen.
%s gathers the materials together and begins to work.
Precisely.
The Icewing Bunker was taken by the Alliance!

Behind me is the Altar of Zanza, a sacred place for us Zandalar.  We pray here to bolster our resolve in preparation for war against the Blood God, Hakkar.$B$BProve yourself to the tribe by using the altar to destroy any of the Hakkari Bijous you might find inside Zul'Gurub.  Also, I will trade you Honor Tokens our tribe uses for sets of coins you may find in Zul'Gurub.  Bring me the coins that I seek, and you will be rewarded!
Not what Keever was hoping for. Keever may have added too much earthroot. Let's see if the second serum will do what I need.
Turn back! Do not wake the dreamer!
Adele Fielder has made a name for herself as a leatherworker around Elwynn.  You can find her working out of her home up by Crystal Lake.
I listen and I listen but I don't hear these spirits that Karn speaks of.
Ahh, you will need to make your way over to the Hunter's Hall then. Several great hunters like Holt Thunderhorn can be found there on the Hunter Rise.
Fine work! You are truly deserving of the knowledge I shall bestow upon you!
Me versus fifty orcs? I'm no fool, $n. My pappy always told me, 'Discreditin is the better part of a cracker,' or something, and I knew what that meant.
Hello!  You're just the person I was looking for.  Take a seat and listen, because I have a plan that will make us both rich!
Information on Brilliant Chromatic Scales.
Daddy!
The ashes from the burning wickerman radiate magical power.

Hey, who Fengus callin' a gnoll lover?!  Take da prisoners to da king; you smart to bring them with their weapons and show da king that they a threat.  I'll go see if Fengus talk smack when I give him da beatdown!  HAR!
The death of our flesh marked the birth of our spirit and our sacred task.
You go to inner ring of The Apothecarium.  Lavinia Crowe is there.
The temperature is 122 degrees Kraklenheit.
To die in battle is glorious! But, with what I teach you, maybe you not die so quickly, hm?
%s refuses to die while its master is endangered!
Indeed, the hills of Winterspring are currently attempting to withstand a renewed Scourge assault. Your assistance would help them greatly.$B$BNumber of Necropolises remaining: $2284W

You're telling me! It's even stranger considering between Brann, Rutgar, me and the monkey, we know 38 different languages including a touch of Titan - both Vanir and Aesir.$B$BSo anyway, whatever she was click clacking about, it definitely wasn't with anyone "present." She then nodded and went on the offensive! Attacked us outright!
No other race on Azeroth has suffered as much as our people, $c. To laugh in the face of death has become second nature for all of us.
Another fool falls for the trap!

The ground upon which the Scholomance was built was given to Kel'Thuzad by the Barov family. In exchange for this land - a place where the Cult of the Damned could learn the foul magics of the Scourge - Kel'Thuzad granted the Barov's immortality through undeath.$B$BIt is in Shadow Vault that you will find both the skin of shadow and its owner, Lady Illucia Barov.$B$BA finer mirror for the vain and dead never existed.
%s senses your fear.
That was a nice shot... but not perfect. Maybe a bit more to the left.
Grumble...
My father told me there'd be days like this, where a stranger would talk to me and I'd have to restrain myself from killing $ghim:her;.
I'd talk to you if you smelled better. Cologne would be nice.
Bijou lost! SQUAWK! *cough*
And heroes... I hold that which you seek. May it once more see the evil dissolved. Remulos, see to it that our champion receives the shard of the Green Flight.
Praise be to Elune... Eranikus is redeemed.

This cauldron churns with thick, green bubbles.  Skulls, bones and organs of unknown creatures swim within its viscous broth...$B$BAnd rising lazily to the surface are the skulls of two, once mighty trolls:$B$BGan'zulah and Nezzliok.
No!  You must not do this!
Good day, Hulfdan, I am looking for training.
